title: Instruments for the Court
description: Quaver has survived long enough to object to a silent Dark Tower. Assemble a string voice and percussion so he can begin organizing a proper Minion court band. Immersive Melodies is the instrument system; this is Quaver's personnel arc, not a generic music tutorial.
description_completed: A Lute and Tiny Drum give Quaver the core of a band. Naturally, he now considers two performers an insultingly modest beginning.
